name: @govibe/hybrid-meter
description: Hybrid AI coding engine: a frontier model plans + reviews while local SLMs execute on-device, with a live cost meter showing what ran free and what was saved.
_license: Open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later (SaaS use must share source). A separate commercial license is available from the copyright holder for closed/SaaS use — dual licensing.
_publishNote: PUBLISH-READY, NOT PUBLISHED. Before `npm publish`: (1) confirm the @govibe scope is registered to your npm account, (2) set the real copyright holder name in LICENSE/README, (3) `npm login`, (4) `npm publish`. Node-only, no build step; bundles the orchestration runtime + hybrid-meter CLI.
